title: result.json (result/v1)
description: The case's return value. Its declared shape is NOT fixed: /input/case.json carries its own output_contract, so every key it declares must appear here (that obligation is checked by V13) while the key NAMES are open — hidden cases name their outputs anything. additionalProperties is therefore true and no fixture key name is required. Always present: case_id, status, sources, uncertainty, change_records, _self_check. A declared key that cannot be delivered appears with a null/[] value plus an uncertainty entry and a record in _unmapped_contract_keys — a declared key is never dropped silently. status is 'ok' only when the run completed and the gate passed; 'partial' names its limits.

_unmapped_contract_keys.description: output_contract keys that matched no exact name or synonym
